summary: No dataset links blastomere volumes to polar-furrow class across phyla. The BioImage Archive has a mouse 4-cell-to-8-cell time-lapse set (S-BIAD1057), Xenbase and Echinobase sit behind a captcha for scripted clients, and searches for ascidian, C. elegans and generic four-cell volume sets found no matching tables.
next_step: Compile furrow class and relative blastomere sizes from published figures and drawings across molluscs, annelids, nematodes and echinoderms, or obtain intact four-cell time-lapse volumes (C. elegans, ascidian) from their consortia; check Xenbase and Echinobase manually in a browser.
obstacles_confirmed: Molluscs, annelids and coelenterates, where many of the classical furrow variants were drawn, are poorly represented in these databases.
Cross-phyla image protocols and stage definitions differ.
